messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — elevated token latency observed on streaming responses across multiple hosts. p95 token latency > 2.5s, GPU queue depth creeping up, autoscale not keeping up. paging oncall.
alex: Acknowledged. Any customer-facing errors? 5xxs?
maria: 5xx spike ~0.6% at the moment, but tail latency is killing throughput. Non-streaming (sync) endpoints are holding steady. Impact concentrated on rdx-3-small and rdx-3-medium chat variants in us-west-2 and eu-west-1.
lee-eng: Looks like continuous batching combined with long-lived SSE connections is starving token slots. We should temporarily stop streaming to shed work and force single-response paths.
alex: Agreed. Plan: 1) flip streaming flag to false on hosted routing (canary 10% -> 100%), 2) tighten rate limits for heavy streaming customers, 3) notify Support & key customers, 4) handoff to next oncall once stable.
tyler: Can we do a partial toggle first? 10% canary to observe impact. If latency falls, roll to 100%.
lee-eng: I'll run the feature flag change. Executing canary now.
deploy-bot: Running command:
```bash
redwoodctl feature set responses.streaming.enabled false --env hosted --canary 10 --reason "live-mitigation: high streaming tail latency"
```
deploy-bot: Canary roll started (10% routing).
alex: Monitor p95 and GPU queue depth for 5 minutes after canary. If p95 drops >30% and queue depth drops, continue to 100%.
maria: Canary window metrics: p95 token latency dropped 38% in the canary cohort; GPU queue depth reduced from 85 to 42 in those hosts. No increase in 5xx outside noise.
lee-eng: Rolling to 100% now.
deploy-bot: Running command:
```bash
redwoodctl feature set responses.streaming.enabled false --env hosted --canary 100 --confirm
```
deploy-bot: Roll to 100% completed.
alex: Confirming smoke test. Tyler, can you run a quick client call to ensure non-streaming path still returns acceptable payloads?
tyler: Running smoke:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rdx-3-small","input":"hi","stream":true}' | head -n 20
```
tyler: Response now returns final JSON body (no SSE frames). latency ~210ms for p50, p95 ~750ms in us-west-2. Looks good.
lee-eng: We're also applying temporary quota adjustments for top streaming tenants to prevent immediate burst load on sync path. Patching rate limits for accounts: acct_842, acct_1092, acct_334.
support: Notifying affected customers with template (short advisory + ETA for re-enable).
support: Template snippet: "We observed elevated streaming tail latency and have temporarily paused streaming responses while we stabilize throughput. No loss of data; requests will be served via non-streaming fallback. We expect to re-enable streaming after metrics are stable for 15m. Contact support if urgent."
alex: Good. Setting internal SLA note and incident status: mitigation in place. Need oncall handoff for overnight monitoring. I'll hand off to Jen.
alex: @jen-sre you're now on incident monitor. Objectives: keep p95 token latency < 1s, GPU queue depth < 30, 5xx rate < 0.5%.
jen-sre: Taking it. I'll set dashboard alerts: p95 > 1s (page), 5xx > 1% (page to ops). Also enable a short-term metric for streaming flag state to avoid accidental re-enable.
jen-sre: Running quick verification of logs for any client errors due to changed streaming behavior. Found a handful of client-side timeouts from chat UI expecting SSE; support is patching customer-facing guidance.
support: Pushing an in-app banner to identified customers and adding a KB note.
lee-eng: Operational note: do NOT re-enable streaming until both: GPU queue depth < 20 for 15m AND p95 token latency < 1s for 15m. We'll also run a 10% canary on re-enable first.
alex: Recording action items: 1) postmortem runbook draft, 2) customer follow-ups, 3) follow-up testing for batching behavior and kernel tuning.
jen-sre: I'll own the overnight checks and will escalate to infra team if we see queue depth rising > 50 again.
alex: Thanks all. Closing active mitigation thread — streaming in quiet-mode across hosted is active. Reopen thread if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:
support: Noted. Customers notified.
jen-sre: Handoff complete to oncall. Monitoring until 07:30 UTC.
on-bot-note: incident_id: INC-1987654321 | mitigation: streaming_quiet_mode | created_by: alex | severity: P2
